prerequisites: Basic mathematical knowledge from school education.

learning_outcomes.text: Students who have successfully studied this module know basic electrical conduction mechanisms and the fundamental laws for calculating currents, voltages, and powers in electrical networks. They can classify the importance of energy efficiency for resource efficiency.

After successful completion of the module, students are able to apply basic mathematical methods for network calculation in time-invariant cases. After passing this module, students can abstract electrical circuits and select and apply the appropriate mathematical methods for calculating electrical networks.
After successfully completing this module, students can describe electrical networks using subject-specific terms.

syllabus_topics: Quantities and units used in electrical engineering
Reference direction systems, sources, Kirchhoff's laws
Network analysis (equivalent sources, superposition, mesh current and node voltage methods, ...
assessment_rules: The graded assessment is an exam. The duration and scope of the exam are as per the valid study regulations.
bibliography: T. Harriehausen, D. Schwarzenau: „Moeller Grundlagen der Elektrotechnik", Springer Vieweg
